question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a blue ball, Bob has a brown ball, Claire has a yellow ball, Dave has a grey ball, Eve has a pink ball, Fred has a white ball, and Gertrude has a purple ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Gertrude and Bob swap balls. Then, Fred and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Dave and Eve swap balls. Then, Gertrude and Bob swap balls. Then, Claire and Fred swap balls. Then, Dave and Gertrude swap balls. Finally, Alice and Eve swap balls. At the end of the game, Dave has the
Options:
(A) blue ball
(B) brown ball
(C) yellow ball
(D) grey ball
(E) pink ball
(F) white ball
(G) purple ball
solution:
Each row lists ball colors in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: blue, brown, yellow, grey, pink, white, purple.
1. Gertrude–Bob: blue, purple, yellow, grey, pink, white, brown.
2. Fred–Gertrude: blue, purple, yellow, grey, pink, brown, white.
3. Dave–Eve: blue, purple, yellow, pink, grey, brown, white.
4. Gertrude–Bob: blue, white, yellow, pink, grey, brown, purple.
5. Claire–Fred: blue, white, brown, pink, grey, yellow, purple.
6. Dave–Gertrude: blue, white, brown, purple, grey, yellow, pink.
7. Alice–Eve: grey, white, brown, purple, blue, yellow, pink.
Dave has the purple ball, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
